subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move the same field to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery out of the UI?
rationale: The technical path is narrow, but the linked request leaves placement open and the PR makes an absolute local path prominent in a user-facing Control UI page.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after the branch is rebased and real running-Control-UI proof shows the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing configPath field to be surfaced in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline UI exposure and rely on existing CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after the branch is rebased and real running-Control-UI proof shows the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest feature-history signal for the Overview presentation surface that would receive this visible row.
